data_objects.meaning: Wide-format country records containing repeated GDP-per-capita observations at labeled calendar years.
data_objects.notes: The monetary currency, price basis, and purchasing-power convention are not declared.

structure.description: Each row is one country or territory, and country is the candidate row key.
The gdpPercap_YEAR columns are a wide repeated-measure time axis at regular five-year intervals and share one undocumented monetary basis.

uncertainties: The GDP currency, nominal-versus-real price basis, reference year, and purchasing-power adjustment are not specified.
The geographic treatment of country and territory labels is not documented.
annotation_notes: Only the declared train.csv and its neutral packet were used as evidence.
